text_en: To the leader: with stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song.
text_cn: 诗歌，交与乐官，和以弦乐。

text_en: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face to shine upon us, Selah
text_cn: 愿天主怜悯我们，并祝福我们； 以自己的慈爱容光照耀我们！（休止）

text_en: that your way may be known upon earth, your saving power among all nations.
text_cn: 为使世人认识他的道路， 万民得知他的救赎。

text_en: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples praise you.
text_cn: 天主，愿万民都称颂你， 愿列邦都赞美你！

text_en: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you judge the peoples with equity and guide the nations upon earth. Selah
text_cn: 万民都要踊跃欢欣， 你以正义统治世人， 且在地上领导万民。(休止)

text_en: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples praise you.
text_cn: 天主，愿万民都称颂你， 愿列邦都赞美你！

text_en: The earth has yielded its increase; God, our God, has blessed us.
text_cn: 大地已经为我们生产百果与五谷， 天主，我们的天主给我们赐下祝福。

text_en: May God continue to bless us; let all the ends of the earth revere him.
text_cn: 愿天主给我们祝福， 愿万民都敬畏天主！
